articles.summary: Treasury Prime is the operating platform for banks in the fintech era. A multi-bank network: 20+ banks, $1.1T in combined assets, 4 million active accounts.
articles.title: Treasury Prime Adds Two Institutions to Industry-Leading Bank Network, Accelerating Embedded Finance Growth

articles.summary: Many banks believe they’ve modernized, but as embedded finance, instant payments, and AI raise the bar, stability alone is no longer enough. Treasury Prime’s Bank OS helps banks evolve beyond static systems to meet the demands of today’s real-time, always-on financial ecosystem.
articles.title: AI as a Catalyst for Transparency in Embedded Finance Partnerships
